title: Native supported cup algebra on either small site
statement: For the finite datum of [def-pur-conventions] and native operations of [def-pur-supported-cup-functoriality-models], on either small site the supported pullback preserves identities and composition, the specified Kummer class is additive on units and natural under scheme pullback, and the specified supported cup is bilinear, associative, graded symmetric with sign (-1)^(ab), and compatible with normalized pullback. These are exactly the eleven fields of FunctorialCupAlgebraLaws.

source.place: Tag 0FPM, lemma-cup-product-commutative (and Tag 0FPL, associativity); supported refinement formulated by the agent from the tensor-morphism construction in def-pur-supported-cup, Stacks Tag 09XP localization, Tag 03PL Kummer sequence, and Tag 0G78 supported functoriality (cohomology.tex). Pro-etale comparison compatibility is part of this auxiliary statement, not an assertion that 0FPM alone states it.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-supported-cup-native-coherence] for the seven coherence, pullback and Kummer fields. For the four remaining fields unfold the prescribed cup composite. Tensor right and left whiskering preserve addition and coefficient scalar multiplication, as do composition and shift. These four direct bilinearity calculations supply add_left, add_right, smul_left and smul_right. Assemble the eleven fields.
